**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on us. My searches across the single Preamble section for "compet", "exclusiv", "restrict", "shall not", "engage in", and "similar services" surfaced no restrictive covenant binding the AP — the "shall not" hits run against Kubient (IP non-infringement warranty, p0033) or are advertising-content standards we accept (p0041), and the exclusivity hits are jurisdiction, trademark-ownership, and entire-agreement boilerplate.

Affirmatively helpful language sits in § 1 (p0001): the arrangement is expressly non-exclusive and the Agreement "will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties." That meets the **preferred** position outright and operates in our favor, so it should not be touched.
